topIssues.title: op-acceptance-tests: switch to op-reth-only sequencing for Karst+
topIssues.author: sebastianst
topIssues.body:
## Context

op-geth is being deprecated as of the **Karst** fork. The accompanying op-geth change ([op-geth#802](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/802)) adds a kill switch: the beacon consensus engine refuses to build, seal, or import any block whose timestamp activates Karst. Consequently, **op-geth can no longer sequence or verify a Karst chain**, and every acceptance-test path that uses op-geth at Karst+ must move to op-reth (the official Karst EL client, which has full Karst support).

This issue tracks making **op-acceptance-tests sequence and verify on op-reth for Karst+** (op-geth remains valid up to and including Jovian).

## Evidence (from the CI probe)

Draft probe PR [#21167](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21167) repins op-geth to the kill-switch commit. CircleCI `memory-all-*` acceptance results:

| EL variant | Failures | Nature |
|---|---|---|
| `memory-all-opn-op-geth` (op-geth EL) | **93** | Broad — op-geth refuses to seal/import Karst blocks (expected) |
| `memory-all-opn-op-reth` (op-reth EL) | **7** | All in supernode sync-tester + interop follow-L2 |

The 7 op-reth-variant failures were the actionable signal: even with `DEVSTACK_L2EL_KIND=op-reth`, these tests still spun up an **op-geth** node and hit the kill switch.

Failing tests:
- `op-acceptance-tests/tests/supernode/sync_tester`: `TestSupernodeVerifierAdvancesViaSyncTester`, `TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsFromCold`, `TestSupernodeVerifierCatchesUpFromCold`, `TestSupernodeVerifierSyncsThroughInteropActivation`, `TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsThroughInteropActivation`
- `op-acceptance-tests/tests/supernode/interop/follow_l2`: `TestFollowSource_P2PSync`, `TestFollowSource_HeadsDivergeThenConverge`

## Root cause: presets that hardcode op-geth

Two devstack constructors called `startL2ELNode` (op-geth) directly instead of the env-aware dispatch `startL2ELForKey` / `startSequencerEL` ([singlechain_build.go#L153](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/singlechain_build.go#L153)):

1. Sync-tester sequencer EL — [singlechain_supernode_synctester_variant.go#L59](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/singlechain_supernode_synctester_variant.go#L59)
2. Follow-L2 follower EL — [multichain_supernode_runtime.go#L515](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/multichain_supernode_runtime.go#L515)

## Approach (decided)

**Karst-aware EL selection + auto-skip op-geth**, implemented at the single EL dispatch point:

1. **De-hardcode op-geth** — route the two spots above through the env-aware dispatch (`startSequencerEL` / `startL2ELForKey`). No behavior change for the op-geth variant; the op-reth variant then truly runs op-reth everywhere.
2. **Karst-aware guard** — in `startL2ELForKey` ([singlechain_build.go#L153](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/singlechain_build.go#L153)) and the mixed-runtime per-node path ([mixed_runtime.go#L182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/mixed_runtime.go#L182)): when `l2Net.ChainConfig().IsKarst(genesis.Timestamp)` and the requested EL is op-geth, `t.Skipf(...)`; otherwise route to op-reth. Net: **on a Karst-at-genesis chain, no op-geth node is ever started** — op-geth-requested tests skip, everything else sequences/verifies on op-reth. No change for ≤ Jovian chains.

### Resolved investigations
- **op-reth as sequencer**: already first-class in devstack (`MixedL2ELOpReth`), driven by the EL-agnostic batcher + test-sequencer over RPC. No new plumbing.
- **`--builder.interval=100ms` / `--builder.deadline`** ([mixed_runtime.go#L333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/8a0fb5a914f8023a90baf9dfcd2c6a56515e6326/op-devstack/sysgo/mixed_runtime.go#L333)): confirmed via `op-reth node --help` these are payload-*job* parameters (how a *requested* payload is refined before `getPayload`/deadline), **not** autonomous sealing. The test-sequencer drives blocks via the Engine API, so there is no race and **no op-reth on-demand/test-mode flag is required** for acceptance.

## Local verification

Branch implementing the above, run against a Karst-at-genesis config:

| Test | EL | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `sync_tester/TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsFromCold` | op-reth | ✅ PASS (op-reth is the sequencer) |
| `sync_tester/TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsFromCold` | op-geth | ⏭️ SKIP (auto-skip fired) |
| `interop/follow_l2/TestFollowSource_P2PSync` | op-reth | ✅ PASS (exercises the follower fix) |

## Acceptance criteria
- With Karst active, no op-geth node is started in any acceptance-test preset/runtime.
- `memory-all-opn-op-reth` and `memory-all-kona-op-reth` are green against a Karst-activated config.
- op-geth coverage for ≤ Jovian is preserved (op-geth variant skips Karst+ tests).

## Out of scope (separate tracks)
- **op-e2e/actions + proofs** — embed op-geth in-process as a Go library; op-reth coverage there is gated on the Rust `op-reth-test-engine` (#20415), which additionally needs *stateful incremental payload building* in op-reth (tx-by-tx). Tracked separately.
- The op-geth kill switch itself ([op-geth#802](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/802)) and the go.mod bump probe ([#21167](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21167)).

topPRs.title: op-devstack: sequence on op-reth for Karst+ in acceptance tests
topPRs.author: sebastianst
topPRs.body:
## Summary

op-geth is being deprecated as of the **Karst** fork and (with [op-geth#802](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/802)) refuses to build, seal, or import Karst blocks. This makes the acceptance-test harness sequence and verify Karst-activated chains on **op-reth** — the official Karst EL client — instead of op-geth.

Resolves the op-reth-variant acceptance failures surfaced by the op-geth bump probe ([#21167](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21167)), where presets that hardcoded op-geth hit the kill switch even under `DEVSTACK_L2EL_KIND=op-reth`.

## Changes

- **De-hardcode op-geth** in the two presets that bypassed the env-aware EL dispatch, so they honor `DEVSTACK_L2EL_KIND`:
  - sync-tester sequencer EL (`singlechain_supernode_synctester_variant.go`) → `startSequencerEL`
  - follow-L2 follower EL (`multichain_supernode_runtime.go`) → `startL2ELForKey`
- **Karst-aware guard** at the EL dispatch point (`startL2ELForKey`) and the mixed-runtime per-node path:
  - **env-selected op-geth** on a Karst-at-genesis chain → **skip** (the op-geth CI lane cannot cover Karst; it still runs ≤ Jovian).
  - **explicit `spec.ELKind = op-geth`** on a Karst chain → **fail** (a test misconfiguration).
  - everything else sequences/verifies on op-reth. No change for ≤ Jovian chains.

## Local verification

Run against a Karst-at-genesis config:

| Test | EL | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `sync_tester/TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsFromCold` | op-reth | ✅ PASS (op-reth is the sequencer) |
| `sync_tester/TestSupernodeVerifierELSyncsFromCold` | op-geth | ⏭️ SKIP (auto-skip fired) |
| `interop/follow_l2/TestFollowSource_P2PSync` | op-reth | ✅ PASS (exercises the follower fix) |

## Notes

- This lands ahead of the op-geth kill switch and is independently green: it's keyed on `ChainConfig.IsKarst(genesis)`, so the op-geth lane already skips Karst-activated tests while the op-reth lane runs them.
- Out of scope: `op-e2e/actions`/proofs op-reth coverage, which is gated on the Rust `op-reth-test-engine` (#20415).

Closes #21182.
